fullContent:
Dasanakanti Churnam 
 Reference: AVS Pharmacopoeia 
 Introduction 
 Dasanakanti Churnam is a blend of iron oxide, hematite and camphor along with other ingredients. It helps in treating dental and gum disorders. 
 Ingredients 
 Powders of:- 
 
 Arimedastwak (Acacia nilotica) 
 Licorice (Glycyrrhiza glabra) 
 Darvi (Berberis aristata) 
 Khadirasara (Acacia catechu) 
 Gairika (Red Ochre) 
 Black pepper (Piper nigrum) 
 Long pepper (Piper longum) 
 Nutmeg (Myristica fragrans) 
 Nutmeg (Myristica fragrans) 
 Kounti Cubeba officinalis 
 Clove (Syzygium aromaticum) 
 Ela (Elettaria cardamomum) 
 Cinnamon (Cinnamomum zeylanica) 
 Camphor 
 Rose water 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Clean all the ingredients and crush them to a fine powder separately. Mix them together till well combined. Store the product in an airtight container away from heat, light and moisture. 
 Dosage / Usage 
 Take a generous amount of this powder and rub it evenly on your teeth and gums with the help of your finger or a soft bristled brush for a few minutes two times every day. 
 Indications 
 
 Teeth strengthener 
 Dental caries 
 Bleeding gums 
 Mouth ulcers 
 Swollen gums 
 Disinfectant 
 Stomatitis 
 Halitosis 
 Helps in repairing worn out teeth and gums 
 Tongue and throat disorders. 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 There are no reported side effects of this formulation. 
 It should be kept away from children. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
